title: Compatibility of the inclusions $E_X\to F_X\to\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}$
statement:
For finite extensions $E\le F$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside $\Qlb$ and every scheme $X$, the
inclusion $E_X\to F_X$ ([def-sfb-subfield-coefficient-map]) followed by $F_X\to\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}$ is
the inclusion $E_X\to\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}$ ([def-sfb-subfield-to-qlbar-coefficient-map]).

proof.text:
By [lem-sfb-coefficient-map-comp] the composite is the coefficient change of the composite
$\underline E\to\underline F\to\underline{\Qlb}$, which is the inclusion
$\underline E\to\underline{\Qlb}$: both send a continuous map $h\colon S\to E$ to $h$ regarded as
a map to $\Qlb$ ([sk-prop-sfb-qlbar-colimit-point]).
